the design of high precision bandgap reference circuit with MOS transistor curvature compensation.
the design and optimization of a high precision bandgap voltage reference.
the design, simulation and implementation of a high precision CMOS bandgap voltage reference.

the proposed BGR is suitable for low voltage and high precision applications.

the presented bandgap reference circuit is suitable for the applications of high precision and low power consumption in the future.
a high accuracy and high precision bandgap reference is achieved by using only one MOS transistor.
we propose a novel bandgap voltage reference with MOS curvature compensation in deep triode region and achieve a good linearity and temperature stability.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the MOS transistor in the strong inversion region can be used to compensate the curvature effect of the MOS transistors in the weak inversion region.
the MOS transistor curvature compensation can be used as a simple and effective method in the design of BGR.
the curvature of a MOSFET in the strong inversion deep triod region is linear and it can be used to compensate the curvature of the MOSFETs in the weak inversion region.
